description: SEC EDGAR company lookup by stock ticker or CIK: revenue, net income, assets, liabilities, equity, cash, EPS and shares from the latest 10-K/10-Q XBRL data, plus recent 10-K, 10-Q and 8-K filings with links, exchange, state of incorporation and industry (SIC). Use when you need a US public company's fundamentals, filings or identity. Signed receipt. Price: $0.003 per call via x402 (USDC on Base or XRP on XRPL). The response includes a `provenance` block (sg-provenance/1): each fact carries its source, source URL, retrieval time and limits; evidence only, no score, rating or verdict. Example arguments: {"ticker":"AAPL"}.

cik.description: SEC Central Index Key (digits); alternative to ticker

ticker.description: US stock ticker; give ticker or cik

name: sec_company_facts

outputSchema.description: Paid result: { data, receipt }. Unpaid calls return an x402 PaymentRequired object instead (isError: true).

data.description: SEC EDGAR identity (CIK, tickers, exchange, SIC, state), latest annual and quarterly XBRL financials, recent filings with links

provenance.description: The response includes a `provenance` block (sg-provenance/1): each fact carries its source, source URL, retrieval time and limits; evidence only, no score, rating or verdict.

receipt.description: Ed25519-signed, hash-chained receipt; verify free with the verify_receipt tool or POST /v1/verify-receipt. New receipts carry a signed `evidence` object: service_version, data_timestamp, validation, terms_version, terms_hash, provenance_hash.

title: SEC EDGAR Financials and Filings
